rows.text: Before Akivili's fall, many vast Express fleets once traveled the universe side by side, working together to weave the silver rails that connected the cosmos. Every Navigator held one of these compasses, which determined direction based on the relative position of pulsars and was rumored to point toward the heart's deepest desire. Now that the Express fleets have run aground, these compasses are lost across the cosmos. However, an anonymous Memokeeper revealed that at least a double-digit number of compasses have been preserved, with some even remaining operational. They might be resting beside dusty photo frames, locked in attic drawers, or clutched in the hands of a child...
